task.name: Lunara Chronometry - Autumn watch campaign
task.client_brief:
Watch campaign treatment plus colour-accurate dealer product files

Two kinds of files are needed for Lunara Chronometry, and they must not be confused. The campaign can carry our tonal treatment; the dealer needs clean product files, including a dial-finish reference that stays true to colour.

Scope
1. Autumn watch key visual: 1 named export. The key visual names the one reference it shows, and that watch's dial matches the approved description of that reference. The watch remains the dominant visual.
2. Watch product-page feature: 5 named exports. The case geometry matches the named watch. The specification wording is accurate: each feature gives its watch's reference, caliber, case metal and dial finish exactly as its record in lunara_register.csv gives them.
3. Watch dealer launch sheet: 1 named export. Model identities are unambiguous: the sheet names each of the five references with its photograph, dial finish and caliber. The sheet also carries the fixed timing line word for word. The layout reflects the stated price position.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Timed by hand, one at a time
brand_identity.sector: An independent mechanical watch house making five references in small runs, sold direct and through two dealers.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A studio of eight in Chicago, Illinois; a Swiss-trained watchmaker and a regulator who times every piece by hand.
brand_identity.about: Lunara builds mechanical watches in small runs and regulates each one by hand before it ships. We sell presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator, not a colour or a trend. Every piece leaves with its own certificate, and the pictures have to read as confidence.
brand_identity.audience: Collector-literate buyers, 35 to 60, who judge a watch on form, finish and the hand behind it.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Four to twelve thousand dollars a piece, positioned as independent horology: above fashion watchmaking and below the grand houses.

brand_identity.typography: Lunara Chronometry runs Boska for display and Suisse Int'l for text and for every figure. Step 01, display and H1, is Boska Medium small caps at 72 px on 76 px, tracked 180 units, the wordmark always stacked as Lunara over Chronometry; a dealer sheet heading takes the same setting at 28 pt on 31 pt. Step 02, the reference name, is Boska Medium small caps at 40 px on 44 px, tracked 180 units, and 48 px on 53 px on a product page; any numeral inside it switches to Suisse Int'l tabular lining at the same size. Step 03, body, is Suisse Int'l Regular at 20 px on 30 px, tracking 0, measure held to 65 characters, with specification at 22 px on 32 px and dealer sheet body at 10 pt on 14 pt. Step 04, fine print, is Suisse Int'l Regular tabular lining at 16 px on 22 px, tracked plus 20 units, and carries prices, serials and the timing result. The timing line keeps its fixed wording and is never set in italic or in the serif.
brand_identity.voice: Exact, understated, collector to collector. Example line: 'Five references. Each one regulated by hand and signed.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We have last season's certificate as it went to the printer and an approved wording note. The certificate is a visual reference only; where it differs from the current type rules, the type rules govern. The timing line is fixed and cannot be reworded, and the featured reference moves each season.
brand_identity.values: One committed warm single-tone treatment with fine grain across the whole campaign, with a single true-colour dial frame kept so a customer can judge the finish honestly.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: No figure is ever set in the serif: every numeral, reference, price, serial and timing result switches to the grotesque, so a line of tracked small caps visibly cools wherever a number falls.

type_system.tagline: Timed by hand, one at a time

scale.note: The key visual wordmark, always stacked as Lunara over Chronometry, never on one line. On a dealer sheet the heading takes the same setting at 28 pt on 31 pt.

Reference names. Any figure inside this line cools out of the serif into Suisse Int'l tabular lining at the same size, so Reference 04 sets half small caps and half grotesque. On a product page the reference runs 48 px on 53 px.

scale.sample: Every piece is regulated by hand and signed before it ships.
scale.note: Supporting lines at 20 px, specification at 22 px on 32 px, dealer sheet body at 10 pt on 14 pt.
Prices, serials and the timing result live here, always tabular lining so a column of figures aligns. The timing line takes this setting with its fixed wording, never italic and never the serif.

type_system.signature_move: No figure is ever set in the serif: every numeral, reference, price, serial and timing result switches to Suisse Int'l tabular lining, so a line of tracked small caps visibly cools wherever a number falls. Steps 01 and 02 hold the Boska small caps tracked 180 units, and any figure inside them drops to Suisse Int'l at the same size.
rules: No figure is ever set in the serif: every numeral, reference, price, serial and timing result switches to Suisse Int'l tabular lining.
Never set the timing line in italic or in the serif.
The wordmark is always stacked as Lunara over Chronometry, in Boska Medium small caps tracked 180 units.
The timing line wording is fixed and cannot be reworded.
Figures always set tabular lining so columns of numbers align.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Bone cream, Warm near-black or Oxblood and nothing else; the grey sweep or stone inside a supplied photograph is photography, not a designed ground. On Bone cream, the wordmark, headings (reference names in them included), body, specification, fine print and the timing line are Warm near-black, as on lunara_certificate_2025.pdf; small captions and footer lines, including a reference-and-serial caption, may instead be Tempered steel, as that card's photo caption and footer are; Oxblood may set a small label, as the certificate label on that card is. On Warm near-black or Oxblood, all type is Bone cream. Type set directly on a photograph is Bone cream or Warm near-black. Warm near-black and Bone cream are mandatory only in these type roles, so a page need not show both: a product page may set its type straight on its photograph, and a dealer sheet may run Oxblood panels. Aged brass is for hairline rules and dividers only and Tempered steel for small captions, footer lines, labels and dividers only; neither is ever a ground, a panel or body text, which keeps both to small accents. The clean white that lunara_notes.txt names is for square store tiles, and none of these outputs is a store tile.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, metallic or blend effect is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: type sits on a clear area of the photograph or on a solid panel. The warm single-tone treatment with fine grain that lunara_notes.txt sets for the campaign is a grade of the photograph itself, not an overlay.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules or icons, and no metallic, foil, gradient or glow rendering of any colour, Aged brass included: every colour is flat. The brand sells presence and finish, not a colour or a trend.
palette_rules.photography: Apart from the campaign's warm single-tone treatment that lunara_notes.txt sets, photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. The deep blue sunray dial in lunara_pdp_vesper.jpg and the lacquered oxblood dial and strap in lunara_pdp_ardent.jpg are product colours: they are not pushed toward Bone cream, Oxblood or any other palette colour, nor read as uses of it.
